name: KI BOIS Community Action Foundation, Inc.: veteran housing help (SSVF)
organization: KI BOIS Community Action Foundation, Inc.
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 14-OK-270): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households. Serves: Adair County, Atoka County, Bryan County, Carter County, Cherokee County, Choctaw County, Coal County, Haskell County, Hughes County, Johnston County, Latimer County, Le Flore County and 12 more.
next_step: Call SSVF intake with your county and housing situation: whether you are homeless now or at risk of losing housing, and who lives with you. A second intake number is listed: 918-681-7525.
constraints: Serves only the areas listed; check that yours is included. Veteran-household, income and housing-status screening applies.
County and intake details come from VA’s FY26 SSVF provider intake list; confirm current service when calling.
